newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sphinx to sell German unit Schock Bad.
newsitem.headline: Sphinx to sell German unit Schock Bad.

text.p: Ceramics maker Sphinx Gustavsberg said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement to sell its German subsidiary Schock Bad GMbH to Burgbad AG.
It said the sale of the unit to German bathroom fittings maker Burgbad for an undisclosed sum would take retroactive effect from January 1, 1997.
The divestment fitted in with the previously announced strategic reorientation of Sphinx's activities, the firm said.

"As part of this reorientation it was decided to no longer produce all parts of the bathroom concept under the company's own control...bathroom appliances activities will be the first to be divested," it said in a statement.

The deal also includes a supply agreement with Burgbad which will enable Sphinx to keep offering complete bathrooms to its clients, the statement added. bathroom appliances in Germany, with total sales of some 140 million guilders.
Schock Bad posted turnover of 50 million guilders in 1996.
